name: Type Hop
summary: Four bold buttons whose letters hop, spin like reels, swing or shuffle, with letter confetti
about: A poster-style set of call-to-action buttons that split their labels into letters. Hover gives each a small letter motion; a press plays a full show: a squash-and-jump with a sliding arrow, slot-machine reels with a sale tag stamp, a sign swinging on its strings, and a code shuffle that locks letter by letter. Each one ends with a burst of letter confetti. Use them for main actions on landing pages, shops and portfolios.
how: Hover, Tab to or tap a button to see its letters hop, roll, tilt or flicker.
Get started: letters squash, leap in a wave and land, then an arrow slides in and nudges.
Shop the sale: every letter spins like a reel and stops left to right, then a -30% tag stamps on.
See our work: the sign lifts on two strings and swings like a pendulum with the letters lagging behind.
Join for free: letters squeeze, scramble and pop as they lock in, then a tick slides in. Every press ends with letter confetti.
